credit-line.decision_rule: An application is approved when the debt-to-income ratio is at or below 40 percent and no account is in active default; otherwise it is declined.
credit-line.system_name: Fixture Lender automated credit line decisioning (test only)
credit-line.violation_condition: The system declined an application that the decision rule required it to approve, approved an application that the rule required it to decline, or relied on a prohibited factor.
